# Safety Remediation (OSHA)

- **Goal / definition of done:** close out the **OSHA citation** from the March 2026 Rockford
  **lockout/tagout (LOTO) amputation-risk incident**, file an accepted **corrective-action plan**,
  and drive **TRIR from 3.1 to under 2.0**.
- **Owner:** [Linda Fowler](../people/linda-fowler.md) (EHS); executed on the floor by
  [Bob Petrakis](../people/bob-petrakis.md) at Rockford.
- **Status:** corrective actions largely in place on the floor; the formal **corrective-action
  plan submission to OSHA is overdue** and awaiting Ray's sign-off (see
  [commitments](../commitments.md)).
- **Why it matters:** safety is Ray's top standing rule and a board-watched metric.

## Open items

- Roll the LOTO procedure changes to the other three plants.
